title: High red luminescence intensity under sunlight exposure of a PMMA polymer doped with a tetrakis Eu3+ β-diketonate complex containing a benzimidazolium counterion
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,435-445
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06451H, Paper
Open Access

Israel P. Assunção, Israel F. Costa, Lucca Blois, Maria Claudia F. C. Felinto, Victor M. Deflon, Rômulo A. Ando, Oscar L. Malta, Hermi F. Brito
New tetrakis Eu3+ and Gd3+ β-diketonate complexes containing benzimidazolium (Bzim) as the counterion were synthesized by the one-pot method and successfully doped into a PMMA matrix at different concentrations.
